action: Prepared two corrected UTF-8 JSONL candidate records and a date-only patch to arabooks lisanarb.tsv. Rendered and visually inspected the linked scans, checked absence from the earlier import attachment, and validated both candidates against Open Library's import schema. Posted both complete records, source links, page locators and date-change instructions to the existing community import request at https://github.com/internetarchive/openlibrary/issues/9726#issuecomment-5639185477. Confirmed the publicly retrievable GitHub comment body exactly matches the prepared contribution. No catalog import, recipient acceptance, or measured reader impact is claimed.
beneficiary: Arabic-language readers and the volunteers completing Open Library's requested Arabic catalog import
boundary: No one at risk becomes evidence; public bibliographic records and printed publication imprints only.
costs: No payments. Public-source reading, local preparation, and one public comment on an existing request for help; recipient review takes time. Uptake and reader impact are not yet established.
